title: Iron Sepulcher Watch
summary: Take the cursed shrine above the sepulcher ruins and hold what you take. Sixty men, a barracks and one household are all Rome could spare: clear the guardians out of the ruins, then drive the dead off the shrine and plant the standard on it.

victory_conditions.description: Burn every cursed guardian from the sepulcher ruins. Kill what cannot die.
Drive the dead from the shrine, then plant the standard on it. Salt the earth where they stood.

optional_objectives.description: Endure both waves from the depths. Do not flinch when the ground tears open.

defeat_conditions.description: The commander falls — the vigil ends. And the dead keep walking.
Stand your ground. The last soldier alone is not a force — he is a sacrifice.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Sixty men and a shrine the local people will not walk past after dark. My orders say investigate. I would sooner burn it and write that we investigated, but the Senate reads.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: There they are. Do not look at the faces. Archers loose, shields close, and nobody chases anything back into that fog.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Pull the wounded back to the household and send for the men we still have. The dead are patient. We can afford to be patient too.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: The lights are out and the ground is quiet. Count them twice and burn what will burn. Whatever was in there stood here before Rome and will stand here after it. Tonight it simply has other business.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: They are getting up again. Do not look at the faces; you will know some of them. Fall back to the road, keep walking, and do not stop to bury anything. It does not stay buried here.

theme: The dead do not rest here. Neither will you.
